assessment: This important study uses complementary cutting-edge CRISPR approaches (CRISPR and CRISPRa) to identify novel determinants of cytotoxic CD8 T cell (CTL)-mediated tumor cell killing in vitro. The Authors use these screens to identify that the integrin-linked kinase ILKAP and the integrin protein ICAM1 both mediate resistance to CTL-mediated killing, leading to a new understanding of how some tumours may evade killing by T cells. The strength of the evidence for these findings is exceptional and backed up by the study of several cancer cell lines as well as human data. This work will be of great interest to tumor immunologists as well as those studying evasion of checkpoint therapy in cancer treatment.
